headword: {残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}

definitions.gloss: balance certificate; proof of account balance
definitions.explanation: An official document issued by a bank that certifies the balance in an account at a specific point in time. Required for visa applications, loan applications, tax filings, and other official procedures.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: A balance certificate is required for the visa application.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}{書|しょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}して→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the bank issue a balance certificate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{一定額|いっていがく}→一定額：27382_itteigaku⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: For a student visa application, you must submit a balance certificate showing at least a certain amount.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧ (balance/remaining amount) and ⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧ (certification/proof). The full formal term is {残高証明書|ざんだかしょうめいしょ}, with ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (document) appended. Particularly relevant for foreigners in Japan who need financial documentation for visa renewals and other immigration procedures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}{書|しょ}: balance certificate (full formal form)
- {残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧: to issue a balance certificate
- {残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit a balance certificate
- {残高証明|ざんだかしょうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧: to obtain a balance certificate

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧: account balance — the amount of money in an account
- ⟦{通帳|つうちょう}→通帳：09924_tsuuchou⟧: bankbook/passbook — another way to show balances
- {収入証明|しゅうにゅうしょうめい}: income certificate — a related financial document
